pages.label: Reverse osmosis desalination
pages.caption: Pressure drives water through a dense polymer membrane while hydrated salt ions are turned away.

pages.label: Electrodialysis and mineral recovery
pages.caption: An electric field pulls cations and anions through charged ion-exchange membranes, separating and concentrating dissolved minerals.

pages.label: Hollow-fibre filtration
pages.caption: Feed flows along the fibre bore and clean water crosses the pores. When foulants build up, a backwash pulse clears the surface.

pages.label: Gas separation
pages.caption: In a mixed-matrix membrane the smaller CO₂ molecules permeate, while larger N₂ and CH₄ molecules are held back.

pages.label: Proton-exchange membrane fuel cell
pages.caption: Hydrogen splits at the anode. Protons cross the membrane while electrons travel through the external circuit to form water at the cathode.

pages.label: Dialysis membrane
pages.caption: Small waste molecules such as urea diffuse across the membrane, while blood cells and proteins stay on the blood side.

pages.label: Air-filtration membrane
pages.caption: A fibrous filter captures airborne particles while clean air flows through; captured particles are released when the filter is regenerated.

pages.label: Single nanopore
pages.caption: A strongly hydrated ion cannot enter the narrow pore, while a weakly hydrated ion sheds its water shell and passes through.
